sources.title: Planning Data documentation
sources.facts: API exposes over 100 datasets; coordinate/UPRN queries, CSV/JSON/GeoJSON/Parquet downloads and OpenAPI are documented; API remains beta.
sources.guard: API response absence does not mean no constraint; coverage varies and production integrations must handle beta changes.

sources.title: About the Planning Data Platform
sources.facts: Data can be downloaded, analysed and used for tools under each dataset's open licence and attribution.
sources.guard: Open availability does not guarantee completeness, legal currency, fitness for purpose or exact-site applicability.

sources.title: Guidance
sources.facts: Supports CSV, GeoJSON, GML, GeoPackage and endpoint URLs; official authority webpage and OGL statement are required.
sources.guard: Published endpoint and successful format check do not validate all records or legal effect.

sources.title: Prepare your data
sources.facts: Service supports Article 4, brownfield, conservation areas, contributions, IFS, listed buildings, plans and TPO; other standards remain in development.
sources.guard: Supported or developing status is not production completeness or national coverage.

sources.title: Publish data on your website
sources.facts: Accepts files or live GIS/API feeds; legal-document records require direct document-url links.
sources.guard: Endpoint presence does not prove continued availability, freshness, document validity or semantic correctness.

sources.title: Local plan data specification
sources.facts: Four datasets are required: plan, boundary, document and timetable; geometry should be polygon/multipolygon and references permanent.
sources.guard: Specification-conformant structure does not establish adoption, current plan status or exact policy effect.

sources.title: Conservation area data specification
sources.facts: Updated 2026-04-10; requires conservation-area and document datasets; supports CSV, GeoJSON, GML, GeoPackage, WFS and ArcGIS API.
sources.guard: OS presumption-to-publish and structural validity do not prove designation currency or consent outcome.

sources.title: Article 4 direction data specification
sources.facts: Directions withdraw specified permitted-development rights across defined areas; documents should be linked from an official documentation webpage.
sources.guard: Area and document records require current legal instrument checks; specification data is not automatic applicability proof.
